title: Communicating with the Entire Population: Machine Translation of Emergency Alerts and Warnings
abstract: arXiv:2610.32842v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: It is essential that we communicate with the entirety of an affected population during a crisis, including those who do not speak a region's dominant language(s). Commercial Translation tools offer a tempting solution to broaden access and can provide a lifeline when no other resources are available. However, Emergency response managers often operate in the dark regarding the quality and adequacy of these automated outputs. In this paper, we conduct a nationwide survey of emergency managers to understand their current workflows, perspectives, and operational challenges. We then evaluate commercial translation tools against these needs, shedding light on their utility and offering practical guidance on how and when these tools can be safely used in emergency response.

translated_title: 与全体民众沟通：紧急警报与预警信息的机器翻译
translated_abstract: 在危机期间，与受影响的全体民众进行沟通至关重要，其中包括那些不讲该地区主流语言的人群。商业翻译工具为扩大信息获取范围提供了一个诱人的解决方案，并且在没有其他资源可用时可以提供一条生命线。然而，应急响应管理者往往对这些自动化输出的质量和充分性一无所知。在本文中，我们对应急管理者进行了全国性调查，以了解他们当前的工作流程、观点和运营挑战。随后，我们根据这些需求评估了商业翻译工具，阐明了它们的实用性，并就如何在紧急响应中安全使用这些工具以及何时使用提供了实用指导。
tldr: 本文通过全国性应急管理者调查了解其真实需求，并据此评估商业机器翻译工具在紧急警报翻译中的表现，为应急响应中如何及何时安全使用翻译工具提供了实用指导。
en_tdlr: Through a nationwide survey of emergency managers, this paper evaluates commercial machine translation tools against real operational needs, providing practical guidance on how and when they can be safely used in emergency response.
